name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: Flight, newsroom hoaxes to 6 Nov; no state named
summary: Hoax bomb threats hit flights and newsrooms up to 6 Nov; no explosives found and no government has named a culprit
state: More than two dozen flights were disrupted on 5 Nov, and on 6 Nov Ireland's RTE and Bulgaria's Nova TV received emailed bomb threats, with RTE evacuating its offices (Reuters via GV Wire). No explosives were found and no government has attributed the threats; Moscow denies involvement (Al Jazeera). Germany's military raised its Russian sabotage threat level to its second-highest in October after a drone carrying explosives was found near an airbase (Defense News). Searches on 9 Nov found no newer incident.
for_you: Air passengers in Europe may face diversions or extra checks at short notice; airlines and airport operators are the first source of flight information. Reports of suspicious objects go to local police.
rubric_hit: Watch: Germany's military raised its Russian sabotage threat level in October after an explosive drone near an airbase; hoax threats have not shut airports or caused casualties
